---
title: "Polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons in air and snow from Fairbanks, Alaska"
author: "Todd Gouin et al."
date: 2010-01-01
description: "Polycyclic Aromatic Hydrocarbons (PAHs) are a pollutant born of incomplete combustion. Among other things, we found that concentrations of PAHs in city snow dumps were 25x greater than in undisturbed snow."
